newsitem.title: GREECE: FOREIGN BANKS SHOW INTEREST FOR BANK/CENTRAL GREECE.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGN BANKS SHOW INTEREST FOR BANK/CENTRAL GREECE.

text.p: The state Agricultural Bank of Greece said in a statement that serious foreign banking organisations have expressed interest in buying a stake in its subsidiary Bank of Central Greece .

The president of Agricultural Bank, Christos Papathanasiou, said the goal of his bank was to secure the highest possible market price from the sale of a stake in the Bank of Central Greece to a serious, credible investor, it said.

Agricultural Bank signed a contract today with Deloitte & Touche and ABN AMRO Bank to be its issue advisors in the sale of a stake of the Bank of Central Greece, it said in a statement. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
